front.title: THE EGO HIJACK
front.copy: The narcissistic urge to overwrite their pain with your own story.

back.title: KILL THE SIGNAL
back.copy: It’s not empathy; it’s competitive suffering. You are jamming their frequency. Shut down your transmitter and receive only.
back.fact: Protocol: Stop 'rescuing' the narrative; listen to receive.

front.title: THE "NO" OVERRIDE
front.copy: When the door slams and your instinct screams "RETREAT."

back.title: STAND YOUR GROUND
back.copy: Panic is a liar. Ask "Why?" It forces the server to process a new request. Turn a dead-end rejection into a negotiation.
back.fact: Protocol: Reframe reflexive rejection with one clarifying question.

front.title: BLUF PROTOCOL
front.copy: The Executive Audience has zero patience for your mystery novel.

back.title: BOTTOM LINE UP FRONT
back.copy: Fire the conclusion first. Evidence second. If you bury the lead, you corrupt the payload. Respect the bandwidth.
back.fact: Protocol: Put the result first; supply evidence concisely.

front.title: THE SYN-ACK HANDSHAKE
front.copy: Trying to upload truth before you establish a link.

back.title: VERIFY CONNECTION
back.copy: Trust is a protocol, not a feeling. You cannot send heavy data until the client sends back the Listening Acknowledgment.
back.fact: Protocol: Request an explicit signal that the listener is ready.

front.title: THE 280‑WORD GAP
front.copy: Your brain processes 500 wpm. They only speak 225.

back.title: SILENCE THE NOISE
back.copy: Your brain wants to fill the gap by writing a reply. That is a memory leak. Force your processor to idle and absorb the incoming stream.
back.fact: Protocol: Pause; absorb the data before you synthesize.

front.title: INFINITE WARFARE
front.copy: Playing to "win" the argument is a Finite Game strategy.

back.title: SURVIVE THE GAME
back.copy: Winning the battle often means killing the ally. Smart leaders play for retention. The goal isn't to beat them; it's to keep them at the table.
back.fact: Protocol: Opt for retention over immediate victory.

front.title: THE BINARY TRAP
front.copy: Asking "Did you like it?" forces a Yes/No execution.

back.title: BREAK THE LOOP
back.copy: Stop coding for binary answers. Ask "How?" and "What?" Open the gate. Force them to render a full story, not a single bit.
back.fact: Protocol: Replace binary prompts with open probes.

front.title: ZERO‑DAY VULNERABILITY
front.copy: The "Expert" bluff. Pretending you know the answer to save face.

back.title: OWN THE EXPLOIT
back.copy: A guess is a bug in the system. "I don't know" is a patch. Radical honesty builds an unbreachable firewall of trust.
back.fact: Protocol: Admit uncertainty to harden credibility.

front.title: SIGNAL‑TO‑NOISE RATIO
front.copy: Emotional language, fluff, and bias in technical documentation.

back.title: PURGE THE STATIC
back.copy: Be objective. Be unambiguous. Emotion is noise. Facts are signal. The Audience demands high-fidelity data.
back.fact: Protocol: Replace opinion with clear, cited facts.

front.title: THE FLIGHT INSTINCT
front.copy: The physical sick feeling of rejection.

back.title: REWIRE THE HARDWARE
back.copy: That feeling isn't death; it's just data. Stay in the pocket. The moment you refuse to run, the monster dissolves into code.
back.fact: Protocol: Name the feeling, reframe it as information.

front.title: HIDDEN STATE SYNC
front.copy: The server (them) knows the truth. The client (you) is guessing.

back.title: DECRYPT THE INTENT
back.copy: People rarely say what they mean. Listening is the decryption key. Find the Source of Truth buried under the words.
back.fact: Protocol: Ask clarifying questions until intent is explicit.

front.title: THE AUDIENCE MISMATCH
front.copy: Sending raw JSON to a user who only reads XML.

back.title: FORMAT OR FAIL
back.copy: If the receiver can't parse your message, the transmission failed. Tailor the protocol. It’s not their job to understand you; it’s your job to be understood.
back.fact: Protocol: Reformat your message to match the receiver.
